title: Academy of the Sacred Heart — claimed by thegentlemen
description: US · Education · ashrosary.org Academy of the Sacred Heart is a private Catholic all-girls school in New Orleans founded in 1867, educating girls from age 1 through grade 12 across two campuses on historic St. Charles Avenue. Ranked the number one Catholic, all-girls and K-12 school in Louisiana by Niche, it enrolls 818 students with a 9 to 1 student-faculty ratio and 18 AP courses. It is part of a global network
